title: Fix infinite loop in admin setup error handling

requirements.text: Fix the infinite loop occurring in AdminSetupNotice component where the 'An admin already exists' error continuously refreshes the page, preventing users from accessing the application
acceptanceCriteria: The admin setup error no longer triggers an automatic page refresh loop
Users can see the error message without the page continuously reloading
The application remains accessible even when admin setup encounters an error
Error state is handled gracefully with a manual retry option instead of automatic refresh

requirements.text: Investigate and resolve the root cause of the 'An admin already exists' error being thrown incorrectly when no admin is actually assigned in the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Backend correctly identifies when no admin exists in the system
Admin assignment succeeds for the first authenticated user on fresh deployments
The hasAdminBeenAssigned flag accurately reflects the actual admin assignment state
No false positive 'admin already exists' errors occur during initial setup

constraints: Must preserve existing AdminSetupNotice component structure and user experience
Cannot break existing admin role verification logic
Must maintain compatibility with Internet Identity authentication flow
nonGoals: Redesigning the admin setup UI beyond fixing the loop
Adding multi-admin support or admin management features
